question: Which of the following groups represents zero valency?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Group **18** of the periodic table represents elements with zero valency.
 
• This group is also known as the **noble gases** which include Helium, Neon, Argon, Krypton, Xenon, and Radon.
 
• Noble gases are characterized by their **inert nature** due to having a complete valence shell, making them highly stable and unlikely to react with other elements.
 
• These elements are used in various applications such as lighting, welding, and in inert gas shields for arc welding.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The concept of valency is crucial in understanding how elements interact and bond with each other to form compounds.
 
• Elements in Group 18 are often used in scientific experiments where a non-reactive environment is required.
 
• Due to their stability, noble gases are also used in the preservation of historical documents and in the filling of incandescent light bulbs to prevent oxidation of the filament.
 
• Helium, a noble gas, is also utilized in cryogenics and as a cooling medium for nuclear reactors.
